narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed during the afternoon and moved west or southwest across southeast Arizona into the evening. The strongest storms produced damaging winds and flash flooding in the Dragoon and St. David areas.
ev: One inch of rain in 30 minutes caused a rapid rise in Dragoon Wash and flash flooding across Sabin Rd. near St. David, making it impassable.
One to two inches of rain fell in less than two hours east and southwest of Gleeson causing flash flooding across parts of Gleeson and Davis Rds.
Two inches of rain in less than an hour southwest of Rio Rico caused roads in the area to become flooded and impassable.
lsr: WATER IS FLOWING OVER GLEESON RD NEAR MILE POST 20.
HEAVY WATER FLOWING OVER DAVIS RD BETWEEN MILE POST 11 AND 13.
